bugs.text: Entry paths from the bottom fly through the player's row, and the 'bc' Boss Galaga path climbs straight up x=112, the player's spawn x. Each stage start rams the player; in the play-test all 3 ships were lost within ~8 s with 0 points (screenshots 2, 3, 4-play-015s).
shotsFired is never incremented, so the results screen always shows SHOTS FIRED 0 and RATIO 0% (5-end.png: HITS 10, SHOTS 0).
Wing-flap animation broken: zako/goei show frame A only 1 tick in 12; Boss Galaga never animates.
A diving boss with two escorts scores 1200 instead of 1,600; the escort count is not reduced when escorts die.
The captured fighter is freed on the first hit while the boss survives, and it appears at the stale capture coordinates instead of the boss's current position.
No pull-up on capture: the ship vanishes and the red fighter appears above the boss instantly. The capture width ignores the beam's drawn widening.
Breathing happens only when all 40 are in formation; any dive or kill switches back to swaying, so breathing is practically never seen.
No READY text on respawn (readyT only gates dives).
Stage badges show one denomination per stage number (stage 2 = '5') instead of composing the stage from 1/5/10/20/30/50 badges.
Goei escorts end their dive mid-screen and then teleport to y=-8 to return.
The challenge results overlay keeps drawing over the next STAGE N overlay because challEnd is only reset in setupStage.
Challenging-stage results show the bonus only for PERFECT; per-wave bonuses are not summarised.

summary: A compact, well-sectioned single file with a proper fixed-timestep loop, clean separation of update and render, and most Galaga systems present in working form: curved group entries, dives that return from the top, boss beam dives with escorts, capture, rescue into a dual fighter that loses one half at a time, challenging stages with correct per-hit, per-wave and perfect scoring, synthesized sounds and a localStorage high score. The details undercut how faithful it feels. The bottom entry paths, especially the bosses' straight climb up the player's spawn column, ram the player at every stage start; in the play-test this ended the game in about 8 seconds with no score. The shots-fired counter is never incremented, so the hit-miss ratio is always 0%. Wing flaps barely show and bosses never flap, capture has no pull-up, the freed ship appears at a stale position, breathing is almost never visible, there is no READY text, and the badges follow the wrong rule. A player who learns to dodge the entry lanes gets a recognisable, mostly working Galaga, but it feels rough.
